outputs.explanation: Panel A includes a bar chart of cell death (%) shown as mean ± s.d. across three independent experiments, but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (n=3) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C shows grouped bar charts of cell death (%) across time points, reported as mean ± s.d. of three experiments, but individual data points for each replicate are not shown.
Panel D shows a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
